description: This source file defines the ControlChannel class managing the WebSocket or network control connections, handling state, errors, and events related to control communication in the application. It includes definitions for events, error types, and mechanisms for reconnecting and health-checking the connection.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class managing the control communication channel, including connection state, error handling, event subscriptions, and reconnection logic.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the control channel, either in local or remote mode, and establishes the connection.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint
methods.description: Refreshes the connection endpoint, establishing or re-establishing the connection to the gateway.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the connection and resets relevant state variables.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check of the control channel and returns the resulting data or throws an error.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat
methods.description: Retrieves the last heartbeat event received from the server.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request over the control connection with specified method, parameters, and timeout.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Converts errors into user-friendly message strings for diagnostics.

methods.name: scheduleRecovery
methods.description: Schedules a recovery attempt after disconnection or error, respecting throttling constraints.

methods.name: establishGatewayConnection
methods.description: Establishes the gateway connection and checks its health status.

methods.name: refreshAuthSourceLabel
methods.description: Updates the label indicating the source of authentication used for the connection.

methods.name: formatAuthSource
methods.description: Formats a human-readable string describing the auth source.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event message with optional parameters.

methods.name: startEventStream
methods.description: Starts the background task listening for incoming push events.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events from the control channel, processing different event types.

methods.name: routeWorkActivity
methods.description: Routes activity events to appropriate activity stores based on control events.

methods.name: bridgeToProtocolArgs
methods.description: Converts OpenClawProtocol.AnyCodable data to a dictionary suitable for protocol arguments.
